text:
maria_ops: FYI — got a replacement proposal from Lee at NexaSupply for PO RWD-4532. They want us to cover insurance + customs on the replacements if we pick expedited air. Standard is consolidated sea/air (28 days). Thoughts?
lee_vendor: quick summary from my side — standard replacement lead time ~28 days. Expedited air 5-7 business days at +$1,200/GPU. Insurance usually customer-paid for RMA >14 days; DOA (<14d) covered by vendor. We can consolidate to 2 AWBs to save on customs entries.

todd_fleet: can you paste serials + DOA timestamps? we have 6 GPUs down in us-west-2 cluster, nodes impacted: train-3, replay-5.
maria_ops: posting serials now:
```
SN: RWD-GPU-10723  DOA: 2026-02-03  status: dead-on-arrival?
SN: RWD-GPU-10724  DOA: 2026-01-15  status: intermittent
SN: RWD-GPU-10725  DOA: 2026-02-10  status: hard-fail
SN: RWD-GPU-10726  DOA: 2025-12-02  status: degraded
SN: RWD-GPU-10727  DOA: 2026-02-04  status: dead-on-arrival
SN: RWD-GPU-10728  DOA: 2026-02-05  status: dead-on-arrival
```

kelsey_logistics: consolidation + 2 AWBs sounds good. if vendor can provide DDP (delivered duty paid) we can avoid our customs team prepaying duties. DDP will increase vendor's freight cost though.
rma_bot: RMA ticket #88213 updated -> quote_requested by lee_vendor.

maria_ops: @lee_vendor — a bunch of these are DOA within 14 days (see SN 10723, 10727, 10728). vendor should absorb freight+insurance for DOA per our SLA. can you confirm you'll cover those at no cost? :thinking_face:
lee_vendor: I checked — SN 10723 and 10727/28 show activation logs on first boot that look like DOA, we can mark those as vendor-covered. SN 10725/10726/10724 are older than 14 days. For those, our standard is customer covers inbound freight + insurance. We can offer 50% credit on insurance for post-14d RMAs, or waive insurance if you accept consolidated lane and book return within 10 business days.
todd_fleet: for the three DOA ones, we need replacements ASAP. Could you confirm replacement SKU (GA100-80GB) and whether replacements are new or refurbished? Also need AWB proforma to trigger urgent rack swaps.
lee_vendor: replacements are new-for-old GA100-80GB, qty 6. ETA expedite 5 business days for expedited units (subject to customs), standard 28 days. Proforma AWB & commercial invoice attached (link: https://nexasupply.example/awb/PRF-88213). Incoterms default to DAP.

maria_ops: we need DDP for expedited ones — Redwood will not accept customs/duty hold for critical replacements. vendor to absorb duties for expedited lane or we escalate.
lee_vendor: we can agree to DDP for expedited on the DOA units only if you accept a 30% expedited surcharge (covers additional carrier & duties handling). Otherwise expedited will be DAP and Redwood must clear/import.
kelsey_logistics: if vendor won't do full DDP on all six, they'd at least consolidate 2 AWBs (3 units each) and we can preprocess customs docs to speed clearance. If we prepay duties internally, provide invoice and we'll route to finance for dispute later.
maria_ops: procurement/legal — please advise if we can accept vendor DDP partial or force vendor to waive due to DOA. I'll loop them in.

lee_vendor: small note: one of the units (SN 10726) shows warranty >6 months but heavy usage traces; we can still replace under RMA but will flag for telemetry review. If dispute arises, we may request a usage-adjusted charge.
todd_fleet: telemetry logs attached to ticket show minimal utilization for 10726 in first 72h. not seeing heavy usage. we'll include timestamped metrics.

maria_ops: action items: 1) @lee_vendor confirm which 3 serials are vendor-covered DOA replacements and send DDP proforma for those (we'll accept 30% expedite surcharge if needed). 2) @lee_vendor provide consolidated AWB numbers for standard lane for the remaining units. 3) @kelsey_logistics prepare customs pre-clear path if vendor stays DAP. 4) @todd_fleet validate telemetry export for SN 10726.
lee_vendor: will send updated proforma in ~2h with AWB splits and revised pricing (DDP vs DAP). note: expedited surcharge line will be explicit per unit.

maria_ops: if vendor refuses to absorb insurance for all DOA within 30 days we escalate to account mgmt + dispute any insurance invoice. this is a high-severity capacity hit.
kelsey_logistics: noted — I'll draft the customs workflow and cost-variance doc for finance.
rma_bot: RMA ticket #88213 comment added by maria_ops: "awaiting proforma and AWB split from vendor; expedited DDP confirmation required."
lee_vendor: understood — I'll loop in our AM and legal. expect updated docs before EOD PST. :ship:
